variants.prompt: Bathed in the pulsing neon glow of a chic nightclub, she leans against the bar, her black leather jacket unzipped to reveal a hint of cleavage, her dark skinny jeans hugging every curve as she looks up at the camera with a bold, commanding gaze, her raven tresses falling in loose waves around her heart-shaped face, the shallow depth of field blurring the background into a kaleidoscope of color.
